title: Sprint Engine role manifest
description: A declarative Sprint Engine role. Pure data: the runtime composes the agent prompt from the referenced skill ids. No code is executed, so third-party roles are safe to install (Tier 1). Mirror of src/shared/sprintengine/role-manifest.ts.

summary.description: One-line description of what the role does.

aliases.description: Alternate ids that resolve to this role.

capabilities.description: Declarative role capabilities. Capabilities describe what the role can do; they do not make gates globally required.

phase.description: Quality-gate phase this role can serve when the architect requires it. Defaults to review.

reviews.description: Optional capability tags this role is suited to review.

defaultFocus.description: Default gate focus text used when the architect requires this role as a gate.

soul.description: Ordered skill references composing the role's prompt.
